prompt:
PROPORTION AND DETAIL CORRECTION of the NEW male Xuanwu guard in IMAGE1. His design is useful, but his tiny head and long body do not fit this project's compact cast in IMAGES2/3. Redraw image1 decisively to the SAME head/body relationship as image2/3, while keeping his MALE identity and new armor/shield/halberd design.

BODY PROPORTIONS — highest priority:
Approximately FOUR actual HEAD HEIGHTS from crown of skull to soles, EXCLUDING hair knot and weapon tip. The head unit is real skull plus face to chin.
Enlarge his actual head/skull/face by about 35 percent relative to the body, shorten below-neck torso and both leg segments by approximately 20–25 percent. Shorten neck. This MUST be visibly different from the tall mature realistic-proportion input.
Keep broad healthy masculine shoulders and sturdy proportions, but do not make him obese or muscular armor-block exaggeration. Hands/boots naturally substantial cartoon size. Organic anatomical redraw, no simply squashing the entire image. Head should match the large readable facial scale of image2/3; keep his adult square jaw, neatly shaped beard, swept-back black hair with ivory temple streak and low knot. Front THREE-QUARTER LEFT view with some far-eye/front-face readability, not pure profile. Calm focused confident male face, no copying women's faces.

DESIGN LOCK:
Same new INK-BLACK / BRONZE / OCHRE / IVORY Chinese protective costume, one asymmetric shoulder guard, clean cross-collar, trapezoid chest armor and long-short skirt tabs.
Same oversized ROUND XUANWU SHIELD with a single big tortoise-shell/curled-serpent motif, bronze rim and quiet amber core plane, carried on near arm at screen-right. Adjust shield size with the compact body so face, torso center and both legs remain readable; do not let it become a full-body wall.
Same single straight-shaft short halberd screen-left with one leaf spearpoint and one crescent side blade, coherent shaft/grip, whole weapon fits frame. Shorten overall weapon length in harmony with compact character while keeping it recognizable.
Same grounded upright ready stance, two planted separated boots, one leg supporting, no wide squat or distorted knees.

SIMPLIFICATION — second priority:
The input has too many random little polygon triangles on shield, skin and armor. Merge these into a few LARGE coherent light/front/side masses per material, like the actual cast in images2/3. Shield face has one quiet dark center with big bronze relief, no speckled metal texture. Rim each segment uses 2–3 simple planes. Cloth and trousers have few broad folds. Face/hands organic with one broad warm shadow, no faceted skin. Thick controlled dark contour, matte painted finish, no tiny noise or glossy 3D effects.
One complete full-body male guard only, square warm ivory plain background, generous safe margin around head/halberd tip/shield/boots; do not crop spearhead. No labels, other characters, scene or ground shadow.
purpose: Harmonize the redesigned male Xuanwu guard with actual compact cast proportions and reduce fragmented armor rendering.

initial_design.prompt:
Design a COMPLETELY NEW MALE GUARD hero for this Chinese fantasy game. The user rejected the plain ochre-vest ordinary spearman design and explicitly chose to KEEP THE GUARD MALE. Create a distinctive elite protector with the same design polish and bold graphic identity as the existing female cast.
Images1/2 are ONLY project art, compact proportion and visual sophistication references; do NOT copy their gender, faces, clothing, hair, weapons or palette. Image3 is broad heavy protective volume / gem-icon rendering reference; do not simply make the guard a blue gem.

DESIGN: 玄武镇卫 — black-bronze guardian.
Clearly ADULT mature Chinese man, powerful athletic broad shoulders and solid compact build, roughly FOUR actual heads crown-to-soles, not fat/barrel-shaped and not a tiny-headed realistic giant. Square-but-refined jaw, strong nose, calm alert eyes and restrained short neatly shaped chin beard; capable reliable expression, not angry cartoon eyebrows. NEW hair silhouette: black hair swept back in THREE large solid masses, closely cropped sides, one broad ivory-gray temple streak and a low compact rear knot secured by a simple bronze bar. No tall common peasant topknot, no loose long ponytail or copied female hairstyle.

KEY EQUIPMENT — DISTINCTIVE MAIN SILHOUETTE:
ONE OVERSIZED ROUND XUANWU SHIELD on the near arm at SCREEN RIGHT, held slightly away from body. Broad thick circular shield edge built of only FOUR large bronze rim segments, a dark charcoal-green stone/metal center, and ONE LARGE integrated tortoise-shell / curled-serpent relief rendered as a few broad geometric curves. Make a single graphic emblem, no realistic animal head, tiny runes, studs everywhere, jeweled crown or ornate carving. A restrained warm amber central plane or inset catches light, no neon glow. The shield feels massive and protective, about torso height, yet does not hide the face, torso centerline or both legs. Show a strong turned edge and plausible forearm attachment behind it.
Other hand at SCREEN LEFT holds ONE SIMPLE SHORT HALBERD nearly upright beside him. One continuous dark wooden shaft, strong central leaf-shaped steel spearpoint and ONE short side crescent blade integrated coherently into a bronze collar. No extra branches, huge multi-bladed fantasy weapon or broken shaft. Full head and butt visible. The halberd's restrained vertical balances the shield's dominant large round mass.

COSTUME WITH PURPOSEFUL CHINESE CUT:
Layered Chinese CROSS-COLLAR ivory undergarment under a deep ink-black protective tunic. A SINGLE BROAD bronze-trimmed trapezoid breast panel and a short asymmetric shoulder guard made of two large overlapping plates, tied over substantial cloth; this is Chinese fantasy armor, not western knight plate or peasant padded vest.
Wide low dark waist wrap with one plain square bronze buckle. Two or three broad unequal ochre-gold/dark-charcoal waist-skirt panels, a simple large angular wave/cloud hem motif on ONLY one panel. Dark loose but tapered trousers, substantial high wrapped cloth/leather boots with one bronze shin edge. Forearm guards clean and functional, no repeated tiny armor scales, complicated straps or granular texture.
Quiet strong color hierarchy: mostly INK BLACK / CHARCOAL, warm BRONZE and OCHRE-GOLD secondary, a little IVORY at collar/cuffs. Avoid turning clothing bright red, teal or purple like existing cast. No giant cape; one broad short side/back cloth tail may provide a clear diagonal, not many ribbons.

POSE:
Calm front three-quarter SCREEN LEFT standing. Face, nose, chest, pelvis, knees and boots agree on direction. Upright center of mass, one supporting leg and one slightly forward soft knee, moderate comfortable foot gap; no deep crouch, wide sumo squat, attack lunge or crossed legs. Shield arm braced naturally, halberd hand plausible opposing thumb/fingers around shaft. Exactly two arms and coherent anatomy. Mature male hero with protective presence.

PROJECT GEM-ICON ART:
Confident thick dark silhouette and sparse inner lines; each material uses 2–3 LARGE coherent matte light/shadow groups. Strong broad planes on armor/shield and gently rounded organic skin/clothing, no photorealistic armor, noisy triangular mosaic, tiny crystals, realistic iris, high-gloss speculars, fine facial hairs or intricate engraving. Focal design density concentrated on shield plus face, large quiet garment areas. Fresh character design with a readable black cutout silhouette; visual complexity comparable to the reference cast.
ONE complete full-body male guard only, entire halberd/shield/boots safely inside square plain warm ivory background with generous margins. No text, titles, scene, floor shadow, frame, badges or additional characters.
initial_design.purpose: User requested a true guard redesign and chose not to unify gender; retain male guard, create a distinctive black-bronze Xuanwu shield/short-halberd hero.

visual_review: Distinct black-bronze male guard, large graphic Xuanwu shield and halberd, larger readable head and compact body, reduced fragmented planes, complete grounded figure.
